areas.title: Shopping
areas.say: Finding flowers and paying for them

areas.title: Your account
areas.say: Signing up, signing in and tracking orders

areas.title: Running the shop
areas.say: What the florist does behind the scenes

areas.title: Orders
areas.say: Getting today's bouquets made and out

steps.say: Lands on the home page and sees this week's bouquets
steps.label: See this week's bouquets

detail.sees: A big photo of the bouquet of the week, then a grid of six bouquets with prices.
detail.does: Scrolls, or taps an occasion such as Birthday or Sympathy.
rules: Sold-out bouquets are hidden
Prices include delivery inside the city

steps.say: Filters bouquets by occasion
steps.label: Filter by occasion

detail.sees: Only the bouquets for the chosen occasion, cheapest first.
detail.does: Picks one to look at more closely.

steps.say: Opens a bouquet, picks a size and adds it to the basket
steps.label: Pick a size and add to basket

detail.sees: Photos, the flowers inside, and three sizes: Classic, Deluxe and Grand.
detail.does: Chooses a size and taps Add to basket.
rules: Grand needs two days' notice
The basket badge updates straight away

steps.say: Reviews the basket
steps.label: Review the basket

detail.sees: Each bouquet with its size and price, and the total.
detail.does: Changes a quantity or taps Checkout.
rules: An empty basket shows a link back to the shop

steps.say: Chooses a delivery date and address
steps.label: Choose delivery day and address

detail.sees: A calendar of available days and an address form.
detail.does: Picks a day, enters the address, and says whether it's a gift.
rules: Sundays are closed
Orders after 2pm can't go out the same day

steps.say: Adds a gift message for the card
steps.label: Add a gift message

detail.sees: A card preview and a message box.
detail.does: Writes a short message, up to 200 letters.

steps.say: Pays for the order
steps.label: Pay for the order

detail.sees: The order total and the payment options.
detail.does: Pays by card or with a phone wallet.
rules: Nothing is charged until the bank says yes

steps.say: Sees the order confirmation
steps.label: See the order confirmation

detail.sees: A thank-you message, the order number and the delivery day.

steps.say: Gets a receipt by email
steps.label: Get the email receipt

detail.sees: An email with the order, the delivery day and a link to track it.

steps.say: Enters card details
steps.label: Enter card details

detail.sees: Boxes for the card number, expiry date and security code.
detail.does: Types the card details and taps Pay.
rules: Card numbers never touch our servers

steps.say: Confirms the payment with their bank
steps.label: Confirm with the bank

detail.sees: Their bank's own check, usually a code by text message.
detail.does: Types the code from the bank.

steps.say: The payment goes through, or is declined
steps.label: Payment approved or declined

rules: Declined → the error stays on the page and they can try another card
Approved → on to the confirmation

steps.say: Fills in name, email and password
steps.label: Fill in the sign-up form

detail.sees: A short form with three boxes.
detail.does: Fills it in and taps Create account.
rules: Passwords need at least 10 characters
One account per email address

steps.say: Clicks the link in the welcome email
steps.label: Confirm the email address

detail.sees: A welcome email with a Confirm button.
detail.does: Taps the button.
rules: The link stops working after 24 hours

steps.say: Lands on their new account page
steps.label: Land on the account page

detail.sees: A hello message and their saved addresses.

steps.say: Enters email and password
steps.label: Enter email and password

detail.does: Types their email and password and taps Sign in.
rules: Five wrong tries locks sign-in for 15 minutes

steps.say: Resets a forgotten password
steps.label: Reset a forgotten password

detail.does: Asks for a reset link and chooses a new password.

steps.say: Sees their account
steps.label: See the account

steps.say: Opens the list of past orders
steps.label: Open past orders

detail.sees: Orders newest first, each with its status.

steps.say: Sees where the order is
steps.label: See where the order is

detail.sees: A timeline: Made, Out for delivery, Delivered.
rules: The courier's live map shows only on the delivery day

steps.say: Orders the same bouquet again
steps.label: Order the same bouquet again

detail.does: Taps Order again; the bouquet lands in the basket.

steps.say: Sees today's orders by delivery time
steps.label: See today's orders

detail.sees: A list of today's orders, earliest delivery first, with gift messages.
rules: Only staff accounts can open the studio

steps.say: Marks a bouquet as made
steps.label: Mark a bouquet as made

detail.does: Taps Made once the bouquet is wrapped.

steps.say: Hands it to the courier, and the customer is told

detail.does: Taps Out for delivery.
rules: The customer gets a text with the courier's arrival window

steps.say: Enters the name, price and sizes
steps.label: Enter name, price and sizes

detail.does: Fills in the form; Deluxe and Grand prices are suggested.

steps.say: Uploads photos
steps.label: Upload photos

detail.does: Drags in up to six photos.
rules: Photos are cropped square
Images over 10 MB are refused

steps.say: Publishes it to the shop
steps.label: Publish to the shop

detail.does: Taps Publish; the bouquet appears on the home page.

steps.say: Finds the bouquet in the catalogue
steps.label: Find the bouquet

detail.sees: Every bouquet with its photo and stock status.

steps.say: Switches it to sold out until a chosen date
steps.label: Mark as sold out

detail.does: Flips the Sold out switch and picks a return date.
rules: Sold-out bouquets disappear from the shop straight away
They come back on the return date

steps.say: Opens the weekly sales summary
steps.label: Open the weekly sales

detail.sees: Bouquets sold, revenue and the busiest delivery days.

steps.say: Leaves an email in the footer box
steps.label: Leave an email address

detail.does: Types an email and taps Join.

steps.say: Confirms by email
steps.label: Confirm by email

rules: No emails are sent until they confirm
